name: Health Potion
description: A vial of red liquid that restores 30 HP when consumed.

name: Mana Potion
description: A vial of blue liquid that restores 20 MP when consumed.
flavor_text: The universe distilled into a gulp.

name: Ancient Tome
description: A tome of indecipherable script that seems to rewrite itself when you aren't looking. The System cannot categorize it.
flavor_text: Some knowledge predates the System itself.

name: Coin of Fate
description: A coin that always lands on the side you need, not the side you expect. Passively boosts luck.

name: Void Shard
description: A fragment of something that should not exist within the System's framework. Humming with undefined potential.
flavor_text: The System has no entry for this.

name: Journeyman Hammer
description: A well-balanced smithing hammer with a double-lobe stamp mark and a V between the lobes — Torven's journeyman mark. Fifteen years of craft work in the grip.
flavor_text: A tool that remembers every shape it ever made.

name: Iron Compass Room Key
description: A brass key to Room 3 at the Iron Compass Inn. Good for one night.
flavor_text: It points nowhere, but it opens something.
